subject: Column/row orders of own conmat matrix - should it match with the atlas rois order?

messages.author: 638777fa743438d8
messages.subject: Column/row orders of own conmat matrix - should it match with the atlas rois order?
parts:
Hi Chris, 

This question is related to when I generate my correlation matrix of different rois, should the order of columns/rows of the rois match the order of the provided atlas rois? 

I only see the variable `atlas` being accessed during the `set_brainGraph_attr` function where subject's graph matrices get calculated. But I don't see a key linking my re-arranged conmat roi orders to the atlas rois order. 

Thanks again for your help!

Sean

messages.author: dadcb4fd6a01f8d1
messages.subject: Re: [brainGraph-help] Column/row orders of own conmat matrix - should it match with the atlas rois order?
parts:
Yes, they should be in the same order *unless* you provide the ordering by giving the connectivity matrices column names. In "make_brainGraph" (which is called by "set_brainGraph_attr"), it tries to match the order based on the input with the order of the actual atlas. And for this to work, the names have to be identical to those in the atlas data.table.

Chris
